title: Gunnerus cruise week 44, 30 Oct - 3 Nov 2023, 1-minute values

gunnerus/nav/gps/lat.description: Latitude, mean of the minute (converted from ddmm.mmmm per sample)

gunnerus/nav/gps/lon.description: Longitude, mean of the minute (converted from dddmm.mmmm per sample)

gunnerus/nav/track/cog.source: derived: bearing between the positions one minute before and after, when SOG >= 1 kn; otherwise empty
gunnerus/nav/track/cog.description: Course over ground from the 1-minute track

gunnerus/ops/state.source: derived: power-energy-2023 rules (transit >= 8 kn, manoeuvring >= 0.5 kn, station keeping if azimuth rpm > 5, else stationary)

gunnerus/engine/1/fuel.description: Engine 1 fuel rate (probably computed from load by the logger)

gunnerus/engine/2/fuel.description: Engine 2 fuel rate (probably computed from load by the logger)

gunnerus/engine/3/fuel.description: Engine 3 fuel rate (probably computed from load by the logger)

gunnerus/azimuth/port/rpm.description: Port azimuth propeller speed feedback (unit not documented; rpm assumed)

gunnerus/azimuth/port/load.description: Port azimuth load feedback (percent of 500 kW or kW: not documented)

gunnerus/azimuth/stbd/rpm.description: Starboard azimuth propeller speed feedback (unit not documented; rpm assumed)

gunnerus/azimuth/stbd/load.description: Starboard azimuth load feedback (percent of 500 kW or kW: not documented)

gunnerus/tunnel/bow/feedback.description: Bow tunnel thruster feedback (zero all week)
